findings.heading: Examples / Các ví dụ
findings.proposition: The Vietnamese sentence carries the untranslated English fragment "from within an R projct." immediately before its Vietnamese rendering "bên trong một dự án R", so the same clause appears twice, once in raw English including the source typo "projct".
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader meets a broken sentence with an English fragment and a duplicated clause, and may read "projct" as a distinct technical term rather than a typo for "project".

findings.heading: R projects / Dự án R
findings.proposition: The English says the project folder is portable; the Vietnamese says only that it is self-contained ("khép kín") and drops portability.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader misses one of the two stated motivations for R projects, that the whole folder can be moved or shared between machines, and may not expect the project to run elsewhere unchanged.

findings.heading: Creating an R project / Tạo một dự án R
findings.proposition: The English states the .Rproj file is likely the primary way you will open your project; the Vietnamese states only that the file can act as a shortcut for opening it.
findings.reader_consequence: A Vietnamese reader does not learn that double-clicking the .Rproj file is the recommended default route into a project, and may keep using the File menu route instead.
